main.remarks: A provider-neutral immutable assertion model for embedded access-key evidence.

property.name: AssertionType
property.summary: Semantic assertion type identifier such as token or certificate.

property.name: Format
property.summary: Assertion payload format discriminator such as jwt, jwt/v1, or opaque.

property.name: SerializationIdentifier
property.summary: Stable registry identifier used to dispatch concrete assertion payload serialization and deserialization.

method.name: Deserialize
method.summary: Deserialize an access-key assertion from serialized bytes.
method.returns: Deserialized access-key assertion, or null if deserialization fails.

method.name: DeserializeMemory
method.summary: Deserialize an access-key assertion from serialized bytes without first copying the supplied memory block.
method.returns: Deserialized access-key assertion, or null if deserialization fails.

method.name: TryDeserialize
method.summary: Try to deserialize an access-key assertion from serialized bytes.
method.returns: True if the access-key assertion was deserialized successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryDeserializeMemory
method.summary: Try to deserialize an access-key assertion from serialized bytes provided as memory.
method.returns: True if the access-key assertion was deserialized successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: RegisterDeserializer
method.summary: Register a concrete assertion payload deserializer for a stable serialization identifier.
method.param: Stable registry identifier for the concrete assertion payload format.
Concrete payload deserializer delegate. Implementations must consume the memory synchronously and must not retain or mutate the supplied payload buffer.
method.returns: True if the deserializer was registered; otherwise false for invalid input or an already-registered serialization identifier.

method.name: SerializePayload
method.summary: Serialize the concrete assertion payload bytes that will be wrapped by the tiny base assertion envelope.

method.name: ToSummary
method.summary: Project the access-key assertion into its runtime summary representation.

method.name: TryReadEnvelope
method.summary: Try to read the tiny outer assertion envelope and recover its dispatch identifier and payload bytes.
method.returns: True if the assertion envelope was parsed successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: WriteEnvelope
method.summary: Write the tiny outer assertion envelope for a concrete assertion payload.
method.param: Stable registry identifier for the concrete payload.

field.name: EnvelopeVersion
field.summary: Version identifier for the tiny outer assertion envelope.

field.name: PayloadLengthSize
field.summary: Size in bytes of the concrete payload-length field.

field.name: SerializationIdentifierLengthSize
field.summary: Size in bytes of the serialization-identifier length field.

field.name: Deserializers
field.summary: Registered concrete assertion payload deserializers keyed by serialization identifier.
